name: Hubline Berhad
overview: 2026年公司公告主要为季度业绩、股东大会及年报发布，未披露任何业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减、出售或合约签订事项。
overview_en: In 2026, the company's announcements mainly comprised quarterly results, general meetings and annual report releases, with no disclosed expansion, new business, reduction, disposal or contract wins in any business segment.
